responsibility: Implements 32-bit PowerPC ABI classification, returning and passing aggregates indirectly, widening scalars to 32 bits, and preserving Linux GNU-like target behavior where ignored zero-sized arguments are instead passed indirectly.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/powerpc.rs`, this PowerPC file handles call ABI classification, including indirect aggregate passing and the Linux GNU-like special case for zero-sized arguments, rather than inline-assembly register classes such as CR/XER and their overlap behavior.
